title: organize --apply leaves a tree half-dehydrated, views kept and attachments gone
body: Found by hv on 2026-09-12 while driving `organize --apply`: the tree is left half-dehydrated, views kept and attachments gone. Its two siblings from the same drive are handled: the one-finding-printed-many-times half is fixed by 0318, and naming removals only afterwards was batch 4's trigger. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.
